title: Swingvision Metric0 Weekend vs Weekday Split
dataSources: SwingVision sessions (`swingvision:session`), UTR rating history (`utr:rating`), racket-sport sessions (`racket:session`), stringing and maintenance events (`stringing:service`).
app: SwingVision match video analytics, UTR rating snapshots, court-session logs, and racket stringing reminders streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=swingvision:metric0
| eval dow=strftime(_time,"%u")
| eval bucket=if(dow>=6,"weekend","weekday")
| stats count as events, avg(value) as avg_value by bucket
description: Compares weekend versus weekday event counts and average value for swingvision metric0.
value: Weekend/weekday splits expose lifestyle rhythm changes and work-life boundary shifts.
implementation: Tag swingvision metric0 events as weekend or weekday and compare volume and `value`.
visualization: Side-by-side bar chart for weekend vs weekday.
grandmaExplanation: It combines whether your swingvision metric0 activity looks different on weekends compared with weekdays.
